notes.title: Chaos Rider : A new metroidvania is coming to town
notes.notes:
[b][h2]Chaos Rider : A new metroidvania is coming to town[/h2][/b]
Hello everybody, thank you for tuning in!  I'm excited to announce our new metroidvania game focused on exploration and discovery : Chaos Rider !

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611275/8cfc9336365d038a62dad9eb2aa9dce333e4bd36.jpg[/img]
[b]An epic adventure awaits you
[/b]
After crashing on a forgotten planet as a robotic adventurer, explore and discover the ruins of an ancient civilisation while being on a quest to discover your past and how it's tied to this mysterious world. 

You will encounter deadly dangers on your quest : Dangerous beasts, vicious treasure hunters, crazy scientists, dark spectres and many more.

[b]Exploration focused gameplay with high customisation
[/b]
Chaos Rider greatly rewards exploration with multiple secrets, treasures and upgrades to discover. Choose and carve your own path in this non linear adventure. 

While exploring, the player will have to customise its body with ingenuity to conquer intense combat encounters and cool platforming challenges to reach new areas.

We are a small team of two person to develop this game and it's a massive endeavour but also very rewarding to see it come to fruition after so much work. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611275/96fdaa4c7cd2059d6703c042d12d885a53d0a9e4.jpg[/img]
[b]
[h2]Demo Coming soon
[/h2][/b]
We are excited to announce that an awesome playable demo version is coming soon to the platform! New boss fights , mods , weapons and tools incoming in an exciting demo variant of the game.

What do you love in a metroidvania ? What kind of features would you like to see for this game ? Let us know what you think !

Make sure to add the game to your wish list to get notified when the demo and the final version is out. Thank you for your time ! Stay tuned for more updates soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611275/5f2827d0b5ed1909ebf9bd5e9380644554ea1244.jpg[/img]
